## Objective
- Finish the playable Stock Legends racing game and verify its gameplay and visuals.

## Requirements
- Single-player oval racing with up to 14 AI rivals, randomized liveries, four selectable car generations, and crash damage.
- Multiplayer lobby with generation-filtered rooms, up to 15 drivers and 100 spectators; garage customization and settings.
- Cartoon-style low-poly stock cars and responsive touch controls.
- Do not ask clarifying questions; make reasonable assumptions and briefly note them at completion.
- For visual checks, save a small JPEG (viewport at most 1280px wide) and inspect only the latest screenshot.

## Decisions
- Multiplayer rooms are simulated locally; real network play is not connected.
- Use canvas-rendered oval racing with keyboard, touch buttons, and a steering slider; save preferences in local storage.

## Work State
### Completed
- Added home, race setup, garage, server lobby, settings, and race UI in `index.html`.
- Added responsive styling and visual components in `style.css`.
- Implemented menus, garage customization, settings persistence, canvas scene rendering, race controls, AI cars, lap tracking, collision damage, pause, and results in `game.js`.
- Confirmed `node --check game.js` passes and `index.html` parses; `git diff --check` was run.

### Active
- Run the game and test navigation, persistence, racing controls, damage, lap progression/results, and mobile layout.
- Capture and inspect a current small JPEG; fix any defects and summarize assumptions, including the local-only multiplayer preview.

- (none)

## Next Move
1. Start the project and run browser checks for menu flows, saved preferences, race controls, damage, lap completion/results, and mobile layout.
2. Capture and inspect the latest JPEG at a viewport no wider than 1280px; address any issues found.

## Relevant Files
- `index.html`: Game screens and controls.
- `style.css`: Game visuals and responsive layouts.
- `game.js`: Racing simulation, rendering, menus, customization, and settings.
- `start.sh`: Project startup entry point.
- `capture.sh`: Screenshot capture entry point.

## Important Context
- Changes are uncommitted; `git status --short` showed `game.js`, `index.html`, and `style.css` as untracked.
- No local browser test or screenshot verification has been completed.

## Objective
- Finish and verify the playable Stock Legends racing game in a browser.

## Requirements
- Single-player oval racing with up to 14 AI rivals, randomized liveries, four selectable car generations, and crash damage.
- Multiplayer lobby with generation-filtered rooms, up to 15 drivers and 100 spectators; garage customization and settings.
- Cartoon-style low-poly stock cars and responsive touch controls.
- Multiplayer may be a local-only preview; no real network play is connected.

## Decisions
- Use canvas-rendered oval racing with keyboard, touch buttons, and a steering slider; save preferences in local storage.
- Keep multiplayer rooms simulated locally.

## Work State
### Completed
- Built home, race setup, garage, lobby, settings, and race screens with responsive styling.
